[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (38.7→31.0): Entered oversold territory, continuing downward momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-2.8639→-5.3218): Worsening, signaling strengthening bearish trend.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Lower Band $271.04): Approaching the lower band, suggesting potential for further decline.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($272.11): Support level near the 52-week low and lower Bollinger Band.
· Swing Resistance ($291.59): Immediate short-term resistance level just above the current price.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Potential Lower High): 5-day high is lower than the 20-day high, confirming weakening signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.58x): Contracted volume compared to the 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Downtrend): Bearish trend strengthened due to RSI entering extreme oversold and MACD worsening. Maintain a wait-and-see approach, requiring further indicator confirmation.
